summary: This Old House follows homeowners Evan and Whitney, with their designer mother, as they tour a plumbing fixtures showroom to choose fixtures for two kitchens and a master bath. The video highlights real-world considerations when selecting sinks, tubs, and toilets: a farmhouse sink with depth options, the practicality of two kitchens in one home, a cast-iron drop-in sink and its caulking challenges, and a freestanding soaking tub with an integrated overflow and selectable finishes. Finishes (polished nickel vs brushed bronze) are weighed for maintenance and style, and a modern toilet with no exposed trapway is evaluated for cleanliness. The program culminates in a decision to place an order, illustrating how design, function, and project constraints converge in fixture shopping.
